To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) economic integration has a significant effect on the structure of industry, 2) CEE transition to market economy and CEE integration with Western economies have had a strong impact on the structure of the industry, 3) CEE integration with CMEA has distorted the structure of the economy in the CEE transition economies, 4) the distortions caused by CMEA integration are higher in regions more integrated in the former CMEA, and 5) ex-ante simulations suggest that
the economic geography theory is able to predict the industry location pattern in the CEE after integration and that the CMEA integration has distorted the industry structure.
economic integration has a strong effect on industry location in the CEE, and the effect is stronger the more a country has been integrated in the CMEAs.

a number of issues related to economic integration, including the effects of regional integration on industry location, the impact of CMEA on industry location, and the impact of economic integration on industry location.

the effects of regional integration on industry location.
